treatments.name: Regular physical activity and reduced sedentary time
treatments.population: Individuals of various ages with type 2 diabetes
treatments.summary: Regular physical activity of various types, plus reducing and breaking up sedentary time, improves health and glycemic management.

evidence.quote: People with type 2 diabetes should engage in physical activity regularly and be encouraged to reduce sedentary time and break up sitting time with frequent activity breaks.
evidence.statement: Regular physical activity and frequent breaks in sitting are recommended.

evidence.quote: Various types of physical activity enhance health and glycemic management in people with type 2 diabetes
evidence.statement: Multiple types of physical activity improve health and glucose control.

milestones.label: ACSM position stand on exercise and type 2 diabetes (later updated)
milestones.quote: This consensus statement is an update of the 2010 American College of Sports Medicine position stand on exercise and type 2 diabetes.

milestones.label: 2018 Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans apply to people with type 2 diabetes
milestones.quote: the 2018 Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans apply to all individuals with type 2 diabetes, with a few exceptions and modifications
